content:
Check out our subscription plans to find the best fit for your research needs. Consensus is free to use, with optional subscription plans available for additional features. Visit our Pricing Page to learn more and upgrade.

[Pricing Page](https://consensus.app/pricing/)

---

# **Free Tier**

- **Cost:** $0
- **Description:** Ideal for users just getting started with Consensus. The Free tier gives you access to essential search functionalities, allowing you to explore and familiarize yourself with the platform.
- **Features:**

  - Unlimited Papers searches per month
  - 10 Pro messages per month
  - 3 Deep reviews per month
  - 10 Study Snapshots per month
  - 30 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month

---

# **Pro Subscription**

- **Cost:** $20/month or $144/year (billed annually, equivalent to $12/month)
- **Description:** Our most popular plan! Pro unlocks unlimited Pro Searches plus 15 Deep Searches per month. It’s ideal for users who want full access to advanced AI features for deeper, evidence-based insights.
- **Features:**

  - Unlimited Papers searches per month
  - Unlimited Pro messages per month
  - 15 Deep reviews per month
  - Unlimited Study Snapshots
  - 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month

---

# ** Deep Plan**

- **Cost:** $65/month or $540/year (billed annually, equivalent to $45/month)
- **Description:** Designed for power users, researchers, and clinicians. The Deep plan includes everything in Pro plus 200 Deep Searches per month, making it the best choice for frequent literature reviews and comprehensive research projects.
- **Features:**

  - Unlimited Papers searches per month
  - Unlimited Pro messages per month
  - 200 Deep reviews per month
  - Unlimited Study Snapshots
  - 2,000 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per month

---

# **Teams Plan**

- **Cost:** Custom pricing depending on team size

  - Click "Get Started" under Teams to review pricing: [https://consensus.app/pricing/team/](https://consensus.app/pricing/team/)
- **Description:** Designed for research groups, labs, or academic departments, the Teams Plan provides centralized billing and individual logins for each team member.
- **Features:**

  - All Pro features and 50 Deep reviews per month/user
  - Discounts for up to 200 seats
  - Manage accounts for your organization
  - Centralized billing
  - 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per team member, per month

---

# **Enterprise Plan**

- **Cost:** Email [[email protected]](https://help.consensus.app/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#8bf8eae7eef8cbe8e4e5f8eee5f8fef8a5eafbfb) for a custom quote.
- **Description:** Tailored for large organizations, universities, and institutes with over 200 users. The Enterprise plan provides services for large-scale research needs.
- **Features:**

  - All Team features
  - Greater volume discounts
  - Manage thousands of users
  - Early access to features in development
  - All user data is secure and private
  - Centralized billing & account management
  - Development partner program (for organizations with 500+ users)
  - Library integrations
  - Product training and search optimization sessions for users
  - 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per user, per month

[Learn more](https://consensus.app/home/universities-student/) about how Consensus can work for your university

---

# Curious when your Pro or Deep credits will reset?

You can view your current usage and reset date anytime from your profile > Settings > Subscription.

---

For more details or assistance, please reach out to us via the in-product Support Chat or email us at [email protected].
